name: SalesTouch
tagline: The local CRM and AI drafting layer are straightforward, but SalesTouch's core value is reliable access to LinkedIn's private network: authenticated sessions, live data extraction, residential IP routing, human-paced queues, limits, cooldowns, reconnection, and ongoing adaptation to platform changes. A one-shot clone either stops at manual copy and paste or becomes brittle automation that can put the LinkedIn account at risk.
verdictSummary: NOT REALLY: SalesTouch costs $49/mo ($588/yr). Here's why it survives vibecoding.
